thread:
elaine: Quick heads up — I opened a batch PR to consolidate the phrase bank and merge a few glossary dupes. It also touches a couple of SDK snippets and a migration note for param-casing. Please skim when you can :eyes:
noah: link?
elaine: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4832 — diff is small, main work is renaming variants and adding canonical ids.
noah: cool. Which SDK snippets change?
tara: FYI the JS snippets need updated param names (camelCase -> snake_case) for the new client. I'll take the JS side.
elaine: thanks @tara. There's also a small Python example fix — swapping `model='gpt-3'` to `model='rw/gpt-small'` and a note about quantization defaults.
josh: can we avoid changing public examples that customers already copy? maybe leave old alias and add comment about deprecation instead of replacing?
elaine: yeah good point. For widely-copied snippets I left the alias and added a short deprecation comment and a migration table. The migration guide section has a one-liner with suggested find/replace commands.
kevin: leaving aliases + deprecation comment sounds safe. Can you paste the deprecation comment text here so I can approve tone?
elaine: sure — "Note: the model alias `gpt-3` is deprecated. We recommend switching to explicit catalog identifiers (e.g., `rw/gpt-small`) for predictable behavior. See migration notes below."
noah: tone sounds fine. Maybe shorten to: "Deprecated: `gpt-3`. Use `rw/<model-id>` for stable behavior."
tara: agree with shorter. Also add a tiny code fence for `pip`/`npm` upgrade commands so users can quickly update.
docs-bot: build: docs-site — preview available at https://deployments.preview/redwood/docs/4832 :white_check_mark:
josh: saw preview — `/sdk/js/quickstart` still has the old param case in one spot. I can push a tiny follow-up commit after the merge.
kevin: can we ensure the glossary canonical id stays stable? I saw a rename of "inference runtime" -> "serving runtime" in the PR. That might break some old anchors.
elaine: I created redirect entries in the glossary file and added HTML anchors for both terms. Also updated internal links in the docs tree, but left the human-readable string as an alias.
kevin: excellent. For the release notes, can someone add a short blurb about phrase bank consolidation and the SDK snippet fixes? Even just 1-2 lines under docs-changes.
noah: I can file the release note entry after merge.
ara: (joining late) — sorry, quick question: any changes to voice/tone guidance?
elaine: only a couple of lines in style-guide: prefer "we" for product-facing instructions, avoid imperative-sounding urgency (e.g., "do X now"). I added two examples.
ara: can you paste one example?
elaine: "Instead of: 'You must set the API key', use 'Set your API key' or 'To use the SDK, set your API key.'"
tara: small nit — keep contraction guidance consistent. The guide currently says avoid contractions in security warnings but allow them in conversational examples. I added a short note in the style guide and flagged it for editorial review.
josh: quick check: are there any broken links in the PR? I ran the linkchecker locally — only one 404 for an old support article I removed last month.
elaine: fixed that with a redirect to support/faq-auth.
kevin: after the merge, let's run a docs-regen job that updates code-sample snapshots so CI stays green.
docs-bot: note: linked CI job scheduled: docs/regenerate-snapshots (#2745901234)
noah: timeline — I'd like to merge by EOD so the release note can go in tomorrow's cut. Anyone blocking?
josh: one tiny follow-up commit from me for param case in /sdk/js/quickstart — won't block merge; will open a 1-line PR and tag the main one.
tara: I'll finish the JS snippet changes by 3pm PT.
kevin: I'm good with tone + glossary redirects.
ara: editorial will do a quick pass after merge for contractions and the deprecation wording.
elaine: great — thanks all. If there's no blocker I'll merge at 5:30pm PT and add a release note stub.
noah: thanks — will queue the release note. :rocket:
